Name: Somatic Lattice
Description:
When you cast a spell that isn’t from the eidomancy school, you reorient your connection to the Eidomantic Web and reprogram it. You cast this spell as you cast the target spell. That spell’s attacks and damage becomes eidolic until its effects end. If any creature attempts to use their reaction to negate your spell (such as through counterspell or dispel magic) and must roll an ability check to do so, that ability check is made with disadvantage. Spell attacks you make through the targeted spell have advantage.

You do not have to make an eidomantic check for this spell, but must make one for the target spell as if it was eidomantic.

When you cast this spell to target another spell being cast at 4th level or higher, this spell must be cast at a level equal to one third (rounded up) of the target spell’s level (2nd level for a 4th, 5th and 6th-level target, and 3rd level for 7th, 8th and 9th-level target).
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
